dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet
dialogues.text: (An intact stone tablet upon which elegant but incomprehensible text has been inscribed.)

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (I)
dialogues.text: "Kisra. Kisra Parvezravan. Child of my engendering... Child doomed by my hands to die..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (I)
dialogues.text: "You who once thought your rulership could liberate people from slavery, and unburden mortals from the shackles of the gods..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (I)
dialogues.text: "You once forged a mighty palace with whistling machines, turned this oasis into expanses of farmland..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (I)
dialogues.text: "But an empire of slaves who claim to be free will find itself unmade by the very lies it utters..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (I)
dialogues.text: "May unquenchable arrogance flood your heart, until the heavens and earth themselves are overturned, and the meek and base are flipped over your head..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (I)
dialogues.text: "That day, retribution for Ormazd's ambitions shall come."
